name: dsh-zcode-plugins
description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness bundles porting the ZCode built-in plugins DSH does not ship: PDF, browser-use (with the plugin's own browser in the sidebar), and image-search, plus a keyless reverse image search.

scripts.test: node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/verify-plugins.mjs && node scripts/verify-browser-sidebar.mjs && node scripts/verify-browser-live.mjs && node scripts/verify-browser-live-page.mjs && node scripts/verify-own-browser.mjs

author: Adamaik
